text: dsh-mermaid 是供 DSH 网页客户端使用的 Markdown 图表插件。它通过 bundle 挂载客户端，在聊天和文档 Markdown 中识别 Mermaid 代码块并渲染成图表；代码同时提供缩放、平移、适配视图、复制源文本和全屏查看控件，并监听内容变化与主题切换以更新图表。适合在 DSH 网页会话或文档预览中阅读 Mermaid 流程图等内容。代码未声明密钥或外部服务要求。

dsh-mermaid renders Mermaid code blocks in DSH web markdown as diagrams. It watches chat and document content, refreshes diagrams when content or theme changes, and provides zoom, pan, fit, source copy, and fullscreen controls. The code declares no API keys or external services.
想让 DSH 把 Markdown 里的 Mermaid 代码直接显示成图。
聊天内容里的流程图代码能不能自动变成可视化图表？
我想在 DSH 文档预览里查看 Mermaid 图，而不是读代码块。
dsh-mermaid 的功能「渲染 Mermaid 代码块」：客户端扫描 Markdown 中的代码内容或语言标签，匹配 Mermaid 图表后渲染为图形视图；语法无效时保留代码并显示提示。
dsh-mermaid 的功能「交互查看图表」：打开图表后可缩放、拖动、适配视口、恢复原始大小、复制 Mermaid 源文本并展开全屏查看。

dsh-mermaid README · dsh-mermaid：Render mermaid fenced code blocks as diagrams in DSH markdown.

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin,
packaged as a DSH bundle: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, and
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `mermaid` row into the active profile.
The client half is served from `lib/client.js` (`dsh.client.platform: web`).

dsh-mermaid README · Where it renders：The harness markdown renderer exposes no custom-code-block seam, so the client half
post-processes the rendered DOM: it finds fenced code that is a mermaid diagram, renders it
with mermaid and swaps the code view for the diagram. Because the sweep observes
`document.body`, every surface that renders markdown through the shared renderer is covered:

dsh-mermaid README · Where it renders：Deliberately left as code: the plain-text source view of the preview
(`[data-textpreview-plain]`), diff views, and blocks whose source only starts with a diagram
keyword (a list of keywords, prose that mentions `graph TD`).

dsh-mermaid README · Install：- Desktop app: **Plugins** → install `github:bosenok/dsh-mermaid` (private repository:
  give the machine git access), then enable the bundle.
- CLI: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:bosenok/dsh-mermaid`.
- Local checkout: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:/path/to/dsh-mermaid`.

Enabling the bundle mounts the plugin; HMR applies it to a running app, and a
restart makes sure the client half is rebuilt.

dsh-mermaid README · Install：> Note for the app-managed `desktop` profile: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add`
> only installs the dependency and copies the package; unlike a regular profile
> it does not enable the bundle. Enable it by adding the package name to
> `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` (or through the
> Plugins page). Other profiles enable the installed bundle automatically.

dsh-mermaid README · Versioning：This project follows [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/) (`MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`).
Releases are tagged in git (`v0.1.0` and later `v0.1.x` tags), announced
as GitHub releases and documented in [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md).

`engines.dsh` in `package.json` pins the compatible DSH range.

Bump policy: **patch** — fixes; **minor** — new features without breaking the
configuration; **major** — breaking changes to the configuration, the session
format or the supported DSH range.

dsh-mermaid README · Versioning：`CHANGELOG.md` is generated with [git-cliff](https://git-cliff.org/) from
[Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`cliff.toml`):

```sh
./scripts/changelog.sh                 # print unreleased notes
./scripts/changelog.sh v0.2.0          # add the next release section
git cliff -o CHANGELOG.md              # full regeneration (curated history is kept otherwise)
```

To install a specific release instead of a moving branch, pin the tag:

dsh-mermaid README · Versioning：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "git+ssh://git@github.com/bosenok/dsh-mermaid.git#v0.1.0"
```

Tags are created on `master` by Git Flow; integration builds live on `develop`
(install with `#develop` if you want the latest unreleased code).

dsh-mermaid README · Development：`lib/` is built and committed; the sources live in `src/`. Rebuild the client with
the repository's Vite config (`npx vite build` → `dist/`, then the wrapper in
`build/wrapper.js` produces `lib/client.js`).

dsh-mermaid README · License：MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Third-party code bundled into `lib/` and its
licenses are listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

dsh-mermaid README · Git Flow：Development follows [Git Flow](https://github.com/git-flow/git-flow-next) via the
committable `.gitflow` configuration. In a fresh clone activate it once:

```sh
./scripts/gitflow-setup.sh
```

(The script runs `git flow config sync` and creates the local `master`/`develop`
branches. `git flow config sync` alone is enough if both base branches already
exist.)

dsh-mermaid README · Git Flow：| Branch | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `master` | released code only; every commit here is tagged `vX.Y.Z` |
| `develop` | integration branch (repository default branch) |
| `feature/*` | one change, started from and finished into `develop` |
| `release/*` | stabilization, started from `develop`, finished into `master` + `develop` |
| `hotfix/*` | urgent production fix, started from `master`, finished into both |

```sh
git flow feature start my-change
